activity.notes: Jayavarman II is conventionally treated as the founder-ruler of the Khmer Empire, with a reign commonly summarized as 802–850. Because early Khmer chronology is reconstructed from later inscriptions and older scholarship gives variant terminal dates, ATLAS marks both boundaries approximate.
